route: analogy retrieval vs recognition, structural decomposition, cross-analogy confirmation, contrastive relational evaluation, scientific inspiration retrieval, structure-guided retrieval

sources.source: Chen et al., Analogical Deep Research: Retrieving and Integrating Historical Analogies for Foresight Analysis, arXiv:2607.13602, 2026
sources.projection: Deep-research agents tend to match surface features rather than mechanisms in historical analogy search; CANA uses structural decomposition and cross-analogy confirmation, and its formalism distinguishes surface description from mechanistic structure.
rakl_mapping: supports mechanism/structure-first retrieval rather than surface similarity
supports explicit multi-analogy coverage/confirmation as a proposal-strengthening operation
requires RAKL to keep confirmation distinct from target-domain authority
sources.novelty_effect: mechanism-aligned analogy retrieval and cross-analogy confirmation are prior art; do not claim them individually

sources.source: Liu et al., ResearchBench: Benchmarking LLMs in Scientific Discovery via Inspiration-Based Task Decomposition, Findings of ACL 2026
sources.projection: Scientific discovery can be benchmarked through separately scored inspiration retrieval, hypothesis composition and hypothesis ranking subtasks on a contamination-aware corpus.
rakl_mapping: reinforces stage-separated evaluation rather than one end-to-end discovery score
motivates frozen corpus identity and stage-localized errors for scientific JUMP evaluation

sources.source: Das and Balke, From Prototypical to Relational: How LLMs Navigate Complex Analogies, INLG 2025
sources.projection: A benchmark with semantically plausible distractors evaluates ranked relational overlap separately from embedding/context similarity and prototypicality; fine-grained relational mapping remains more difficult than surface-semantic measures.
rakl_mapping: recognition should score relational mapping rather than reuse retrieval similarity
surface-plausible distractors are necessary hostile controls
sources.novelty_effect: relational-overlap evaluation and plausible analogy distractors are prior art

sources.source: Zhang and Lyu, Can Language Models Serve as Analogy Annotators?, Findings of ACL 2025
sources.projection: A3E uses a multi-stage progressive structure-mapping workflow to annotate analogy candidates across fine-grained categories.
rakl_mapping: candidate retrieval and analogy annotation/recognition should remain distinct replaceable modules
fine-grained analogy status can be represented explicitly rather than as one score
sources.novelty_effect: multi-stage LLM analogy annotation is prior art

sources.source: Khojasteh et al., Enhancing Structural Mapping with LLM-derived Abstractions for Analogical Reasoning in Narratives, arXiv:2603.29997, 2026
sources.projection: YARN modularizes unit extraction, multiple abstraction levels and local/global structural mapping; its error analysis identifies abstraction-level choice and implicit causality as unresolved challenges.
rakl_mapping: supports the L0-L6 abstraction ladder as an experimental coordinate rather than a monotone hierarchy
supports recording which abstraction/retrieval route surfaced a candidate
sources.novelty_effect: LLM abstraction before structural mapping and multi-level abstraction comparison are prior art

sources.source: Xie et al., Structure Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Factual Queries, ACL 2026
sources.projection: SG-RAG formulates retrieval with structural constraints as embedding-based subgraph matching rather than relying only on vector similarity.
rakl_mapping: graph/subgraph retrieval is a replaceable structural retrieval route for JUMP
structure-aware retrieval must be benchmarked against lexical/embedding routes under the same frozen corpus and top-k budget

open_source_frameworks_inspected.projection: executable unit -> abstraction -> stage/super-unit -> local/global mapping pipeline
open implementation/data for multi-stage analogy annotation

remaining_candidate_contribution: The narrower RAKL synthesis is an evidence-governed analogy discovery ledger that separates corpus coverage, retrieval, witness construction and target transfer, binds each retrieved candidate to route provenance and frozen chronology, preserves refuted structural witnesses, and prevents cross-analogy corroboration from escalating target authority. This remains provisional pending real far-domain retrieval experiments and adversarial prior-art review.
